A letter from the heart

Dear Brother,

Happy Birthday to the most wonderful brother! 💛

I may not say it every day, but having you as my brother is one of the sweetest blessings in my life. Thank you for the memories, the laughs, and all the little moments that mean more than words can explain.

On your special day, I wish you happiness that lasts, success that makes you proud, good health, and the courage to chase every dream in your heart.

No matter how much life changes, you will always be someone very special to me.

With lots of love, always 💗
